title: FIREWALL
description: HELIX received the fourteen operator profiles. Break into its research wing and find out why.
goal: Breach HELIX, decrypt Project LAZARUS and read it.
hint: firewall helix -> login tech_lee -> cd /research -> decrypt project_lazarus.enc

helix_access.txt: pulled these from the relay logs, don't lose them:

messages.text: Credentials for HELIX are in ~/helix_access.txt. Try not to set anything on fire.

story_start: MIRA: "HELIX is a bio-research facility. Its firewall has five slots instead of four. Take your time."
VECTOR: "The memo you want is encrypted. Caesar-style. The shift is a lucky number."

objectives.hint: Type: firewall. Five symbols this time.
Credentials are in your local file helix_access.txt (cat it before you connect).

story_end: PROJECT LAZARUS: subjects are not dead. They are processes. And NEXUS was never merely watching.
